negative_controls.description: A deliberate fetch to a real host must FAIL with OSError inside fixtures/egress_block.py's block and must SUCCEED with the block absent -- both in the same process, immediately before either pytest subprocess is trusted.

A deliberately planted real-network-dependent test must be flagged by probe1 (PASS unblocked -> FAIL blocked) AND named by probe2's trace; a deliberately planted network-TOUCHING but outcome-invariant test must be MISSED by probe1 (its documented detection boundary) yet still named by probe2.

Every nodeid probe1 flags as network-DEPENDENT (outcome changed under block) must also appear in probe2's network-TOUCHING trace -- a dependency cannot exist without a touch. A violation would mean one of the two instruments is broken.

Cross-reference: 1 of the 2 touching test(s) touch but do NOT depend (outcome unchanged when blocked -- the exact 'silently downloading get-pip.py despite comments saying otherwise' shape the catalog's own measured precedent names).
